build_autoencoder_vidtok: build a VidTok autoencoder model to encode and decode video frames into latent representations
encode_video_with_vidtok: encode a batch of video frames into latent representations using the AutoencoderVidTok encode method
decode_latent_to_video: decode latent vectors back into video frames using the AutoencoderVidTok decode method
create_fsq_regularizer: create a finite scalar quantization regularizer for discrete latent code quantization in VQ-VAE models
enable_tiled_vae_decoding: enable tiled VAE decoding to process large videos in memory-efficient overlapping tiles
